event_name: Time 13:49 2019 BELGIAN GRAND PRIX 29 August - 1 September 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (document 32), have considered the following matter and determine the following
offence: Breach of Article 23.5 a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The gearbox of car 99 has been changed before 6 consecutive events have expired. This penalty does not change the fact that the competitor is required to start the race from the rear of the starting grid for a prior infringement.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 99 Gearbox
to: The Team Manager, Alfa Romeo Racing
